QuestInfo.name: Guess Who?
QuestInfo.0: Halflinger twins, Mue and Tommie stops you because they want to play...
QuestInfo.1: Mue and Tommie will give you a gift for differentiating who is who. Go get #rhints#k from the town Halflingers on how to tell them apart.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to tell Mue and Tommie apart with the hints you recieved from the town Halflingers. Tommie is 1mm taller than Mue and Mue's eyes are twice the size of Tommie's eyes and Tommie always smails.

0.0: You there! Yes you, why don't you play with us!

yes.0: Let us introduce ourselves! We are #rMue and Tommie#k! I'm not going to tell which one of you is which! It's more fun that way.
yes.1: Can't tell us apart? Ask around! The Halflingers in town can give you #rhints#k!

default.0: Get #rhints#k from the Halflingers in town! Heh heh!
